summary: Muay Thai Fever is a Muay Thai gym in Suthep, Chiang Mai, offering group and private classes, rooms to stay and train, and DTV application support.

facts.label: Session price
facts.value: Group classes from 400 THB, private from 700 THB

facts.label: DTV
facts.value: Sends an invitation letter and certificates for a DTV application after training is paid
facts.quote: Pay for your training, and we will send you an invitation letter and all required certificates for your application at your local embassy.

facts.label: Coaches
facts.value: Coaching team holds 4 Lumpinee, 2 Thailand and 4 Northern Thailand titles
facts.quote: Our coaching team boasts 4 Lumpinee titles, 2 Thailand titles and 4 Northern Thailand titles

facts.label: Levels
facts.quote: From complete beginners to professional fighters

facts.label: Drop-in
facts.value: Daily training accepted without a membership

facts.label: Location
facts.value: At the Almag Sports Complex, Suthep, Chiang Mai
facts.quote: Located at The Almag Sports Complex
